main_text.l: vobis, Prov.4.2. Aff. לִקְחִי Doctrina mea, Deuteron.32.2.
לקח m. Faux, Captura: Num.31.26. Plur. cum Affix. מִדֶּבֶק מַלְקְחָי Adhaeret faucibus meis, vel, Palato meo, ut Kimchi & R.Salomon volunt, Psal.22.16.
מַלְקָחַיִם m.d. Forcipes, quasi Acceptoria dicas, 1.Reg.7. v.49. Et מ cum Pathach, & Affixo, מַלְקָחֶיהָ Et forcipes ejus, Exod.25.38.
מַקַּח m. Acceptio, Sumptio: Constr. מִקַּח שֵׁחַ וּמַקַּח Aut sumptio muneris, 2.Par.19.7. Apud Rabbinos Emptio, ut supra in Verbo.
מַקָּחוֹת f.pl. Merces, res quae emuntur & accipiuntur, Nehem.10.31.

לָקַט Legit, Collegit: Praet. לָקַט לֶחֶם Collegerunt panem, Exod.16.22. Inf. לִקְטּ Ad colligendum, v.27. Pih. Praeter. אֲשֶׁר לִקֵּט אֶת Quod legerat, Ruth.2. v.18. Partic. מְלַקֵּט Ut qui legit, Jesa.17.5. Pyh. Futur. תְלַקְּטוּ Colligemini, Jesa.27.12. Hithp. Futur. וַיִּתְלַקְּטוּ Et collegerunt se, Jud.11.3.
לְקוֹט m. Pera, sic dicta, quod in eam res necessariae Colligantur, 1.Sam.17.40.
לָקַק Lambit, Linxit: Praeter. לָקְקוּ הַכְּלָבִים Linxerunt canes, 1.Reg.21.19. Fut. יִלּוֹק Lincturi funt, Ibidem: יִלַּק Lambet, Jud.7.5. Pih. Part. הַמְלַקְּקִים Qui lamberant, Jud.7.6.
לַק Bruchus, Locustae species: vel Melolontha, Scarabaei species, Joel.1.4. sic dicta, quod quasi Lambendo viriditatem abfumat, ut Ab.Esra notat.
לִקֵּשׁ Pih. Collegit, sed proprie feros fructus, unde & Vindemiavit: וְכֶרֶם רָשָׁע יְלַקְּשׁוּ Et vineam improbi vindemiabunt, Job.24.6. q.d. Serotinabunt, Sero

page.notes: Hebrew headwords in the left margin (לקט, לקק, לק, לקש) are set large beside their entries; they are recorded as notes at the start of each entry. Vowel points on several Hebrew words are small and partly doubtful, notably in לְקוֹט, מַלְקָחַיִם and the Pih./Pyh. forms; they are copied as far as legible. The catchword "colligent" is at the lower right of the last line.
